result.title: Constraint-Aware Test-Time Scoring for LLM and VLM Candidate Selection
result.summary: When an LLM or VLM produces several candidate answers, picking the best one usually relies on the model's own confidence, a learned judge model, or a domain check. Each has a known weakness: an answer can be fluent but insecure, mathematically plausible but physically infeasible, or rated highly by a judge while quietly breaking a task requirement. We propose a scoring framework that combines a small set of hard checks every answer must pass with a wider set of softer checks whose scores are blended into one number per candidate. This adaptive scoring framework consists of three components: a drafting model that produces the candidates, a configuring model that selects and weights the checks for each task, and scoring models that rate properties no grounded tool can compute. We apply our proposed method to four tasks: writing code that is both correct and secure (CWEval), generating robot manipulation plans (LIBERO with added safety variants), passing competitive-programming hidden tests (LiveCodeBench), and answering questions from retrieved documents (HotpotQA). An ablation study isolates the contribution of each component and finds that the largest gains come from combining hard checks with candidate comparison: on tasks where the first sampled answer is often broken or unsafe, this pairing lifts joint correctness-and-safety by up to +0.21 (retrieval-augmented QA) and code-generation safety by up to +0.28 (CWEval), with the size of the gain tracking how weak the first sample is, falling to near zero or slightly negative where it is already strong. The per-task layer that selects and weights the softer checks adds no measurable value over simpler alternatives. This builds a unified scoring framework, together with an ablation that identifies the grounded hard checks, not the soft-factor configuration, as the source of the gain.

AI.brief_summary: 提出一种面向 LLM/VLM 候选答案的测试时评分框架，将少量硬约束检查与可学习的软检查加权结合，并由配置模型为不同任务选择检查项；在代码安全、机器人操作规划、竞赛编程和检索问答上评估，消融显示主要收益来自硬检查与候选比较的配合。
AI.relevance_reason: 其“硬约束过滤＋候选比较＋软评分”可作为一种外部验证与答案选择信号，供核查 LVR 中如何筛选视觉证据和支持性候选；但论文未涉及 latent 状态生成、视觉旁路或停止决策，联系较间接。
